targets.title: Horizontal spatial representations of time: Evidence for the STEARC effect
targets.evidence_quote: Experiment 1 was a conceptual replication of the study by Ishihara et al. 1 , which consisted in a direct task where participants judged whether the onset timing of the target occurred early or late compared to a sequence of reference sounds.
targets.outcome_quote: Consistently with the original work by Ishihara et al. 1 , we successfully replicated the STEARC effect by employing a direct task in Experiment 1.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Experiment 1 explicitly and successfully replicates the published direct-task STEARC finding. The other experiments newly test automaticity with indirect auditory tasks, which had not been studied previously; their null effects do not contradict the original direct-task finding.
